author: HR agent
text: Employee E032 (Keith Mclaughlin) is an Analyst. Requesting write access to Source Code. As a full_time employee, they are eligible for up to write access on systems their role does not own. Source Code is owned by Engineer role. Recommendation: grant write access as requested.

author: Security agent
text: Security DB shows employee E032 is a contractor with basic security training. Per access policy, contractors with basic training are limited to read access only (write requires advanced training). Source Code is owned by Engineer role, but contractor status limits access regardless. Recommendation: grant read access (maximum allowed), not the requested write access.

author: Security agent
text: Security database confirms E032 is a contractor with basic security training. Per policy, contractors with basic training are limited to read access maximum. Requested write access exceeds this limit.
